evidence.title: Animated React Charts — Heatmaps and Price Targets · beUI
Animated Components for React and Next.js · beUI

name: Animated React Charts
summary: Animated React chart components: activity heatmaps, monthly returns calendars, price target fans, treemaps and more.
description: A charts collection in beUI: composable, animated React chart components with shared tooltips and scrub interactions — Heat Calendar, Returns Calendar, Price Target Fan, Treemap, Volume Profile, Status Bar, Composition Chart, Funnel Chart, Liquidity Heatmap, Bump Chart and Order Book. Supply your own data; copy the source or install with the shadcn CLI.
contains: composable chart parts: Grid, Legend, Tooltip, Header, Plot, SVG, Axes, Cursor
Heat Calendar: activity calendar with controlled range selection and UTC dates
Returns Calendar: monthly returns with compounded totals
Price Target Fan: price history and targets, scrubbed with pointer or keyboard
also treemap, volume profile, status bar, composition, funnel, liquidity heatmap, bump and order book
copy the source or install with the shadcn CLI
